message: Current seeded data lacks temporal variation. All incidents have similar timestamps from the database seeding process. Real anomaly detection requires actual crime data with meaningful date ranges.
limitation: To enable this feature, the system needs geocoded crime records with actual incident dates spanning weeks/months. This would allow detecting unusual spikes like '15 incidents in one week vs. normal 2-3'.

example_output_when_real_data_available.description: Unusual spike in crime activity detected
